name: Hail of Needles (1/Day)
description: When reduced below 10 hp (even below 0 hp), the creature releases a hail of needles as a reaction. All creatures within 15 feet take 21 (6d6) piercing damage, or half damage with a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.
